caption:
You do whatever you want and still feel trapped. What if real freedom is the power to say no to yourself? (Galatians 2:3-5 devotional)

You do whatever you want and still feel caged, because letting every impulse rule you was never freedom. Real freedom is the power to say no to yourself: Titus stayed uncircumcised and Timothy was circumcised — not a contradiction, but one freedom governing itself for love. In Christ you finally hold the rein, no longer dragged by your appetites but free enough to say no.
